children: Luxfer announced that the HSR waiting period for its proposed sale to a Wynnchurch-backed buyer has expired.
Transaction Agreement signed for Buyer to acquire all issued share capital via English law scheme of arrangement.
Hart-Scott-Rodino waiting period expired Sept. 8, 2026, satisfying one closing condition for the deal.
Transaction still subject to shareholder approval, High Court sanction and other customary regulatory approvals.
Preliminary proxy filed Aug. 26, 2026; definitive proxy and related materials will be provided to securityholders.
